description:
Hushfeed v0.45.2 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Settings search now keeps the query visible when you open a result and press Back. The filtered result list and search box stay in sync.

Validation: 1431 runtime tests passed locally, plus 241 patch tests. The bundle carries 91 patches and a non-empty classes.dex. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.
